Thank you for contributing to Wookieepedia! Before posting talk page comments, please familiarize yourself with the disclaimer at the top of talk pages, {{Tl|Talkheader}}. Talk pages are for discussion related to changes to the article, ''not'' for a discussion about the topic in question. If you would like to discuss ''Star Wars'' with other fans, feel free to explore the [[Wookieepedia:Discussions|Discussions forums]] or join our [[Wookieepedia:Discord|Discord server]]. {{{1|}}}<!-- Template:Msg-talk --><noinclude>
==Usage==
Type <code><nowiki>{{subst:Msg-talk|~~~~}}</nowiki></code> to place the above warning on a user's talk page.
